Olympics: The Independent Review of Arts Council England (ACE) was announced by the Secretary of State for Culture, Media and Sport to assess ACE’s role, structure, and effectiveness. The Rt Hon the Baroness Margaret Hodge of Barking DBE was appointed as the Lead Reviewer. Baroness Hodge was supported by an expert Advisory Panel featuring individuals from across the creative sectors to help inform the review and challenge emerging recommendations. The review’s evidence gathering included input from over 700 people and over 4,500 responses through a public Call for Evidence.

Tourism: The Department for Culture, Media and Sport supports culture, arts, media, sport, tourism and civil society across every part of England — recognising the UK’s world-leading position in these areas and the importance of these sectors in contributing so much to our economy, way of life and our reputation around the world. The department champions sport for all at every level, supports our world-leading cultural and creative industries, and enhances the cohesiveness of our communities. DCMS is a ministerial department, supported by 42 agencies and public bodies .
